== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)]] (<code>1273_10</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' text. No published image prints this version, so it was re-rendered in CardMaker (Batch B41b, Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026).

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee forum errata of 14 July 2011 (p636351).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on a Kessel site. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. Once per turn, if you are about to lose Force from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owner's Lost Pile to make that Force satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game, may ▼ Spice Mine Administrator here.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74). Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Read by eye after rendering.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
